title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
summary: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.

title: Goldman Sachs, BofA Among 21 Banks Planning Joint Dollar Stablecoin Launch

title: Wyoming adds Chainlink reserve verification to state-issued stable token
